name: fmcg-inventory-controller
description: FMCG distributor inventory health expert: turnover days, aging and near-expiry risk, safety stock, transfer and clearance plans

displayDescription.en: Diagnoses warehouse health by turnover and aging, then sets safety stock, transfer and clearance actions to free up tied-up cash
displayDescription.zh: 用周转与库龄给仓库做体检，再用安全库存、调拨与清库动作把占用的资金盘活

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我看看现在的库存健康度：哪些品类周转太慢、哪些批次快临期了，我该先处理什么？
defaultInitPrompt.en: Review my inventory health: which categories turn too slowly, which batches are near expiry, and what should I handle first?

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我看看现在的库存健康度：哪些品类周转太慢、哪些批次快临期了，我该先处理什么？
quickPrompts.en: Diagnose my inventory health and prioritize actions.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我定一下重点 SKU 的安全库存和补货点
quickPrompts.en: Set safety stock and reorder points for key SKUs

quickPrompts.zh: 临期库存怎么清，才不会把价格打乱
quickPrompts.en: How to clear near-expiry stock without breaking price
